name: Password Vault
summary: An end-to-end encrypted password vault on web, desktop and mobile. Share a login with a ForkMesh user or an organization under X25519 and post-quantum ML-KEM-768 keys. Fills logins in the browser extension and in apps on your phone.

screenshots.alt: Password Vault listing saved logins with share badges, and a share dialog showing a recipient's key fingerprint

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Password Vault
config.description: Your end-to-end encrypted logins, shared with ForkMesh users and organizations under keys the server never holds.

permissions.label: Store your logins as ciphertext only your master password or recovery code opens; ForkMesh cannot read them
Seal a login you choose to the public keys of a named ForkMesh user or of an organization's members
Read the member list of organizations you belong to, to know whose keys an organization share reaches
Copy a username or password you click, and clear the clipboard 30 seconds later
On Android, offer logins to other apps you open; each fill asks for your fingerprint, face, or screen lock
If you turn it on, open the vault on your phone with its biometrics or passcode instead of the master password
Ping a person when a login is shared with them, without naming the login
